summary: The desktop CSS follows the agreed scope and preserves existing mobile rules, shared navigation, labels, handlers, and save-row placement; no product layout defect was established by source review. However, required acceptance coverage and measurement evidence are incomplete, so this is not ready to merge. git diff --check and node tests/verify.js passed. The tester reports 196 passing tests, but this review could not independently confirm browser behavior: all 39 task cases failed before execution because Chromium exited at sandbox_host_linux.cc:41 with Operation not permitted. The reports' earlier Git blocker is no longer a missing-change issue: implementation and tester commits are present on this branch.
findings: Complete the explicit acceptance checks in tests/02-adapt-the-menu-for-small-screens/laptop-header.spec.js: run the 1280px save-action spy test in both RO and EN, and add hit tests for every header button before any click can auto-scroll it. Current interaction coverage uses only RO and elementFromPoint checks only the cloud status link.

Replace the partial toolbar inventory in inspectDesktop with an explicit expected selector list covering every normally visible toolbar button, select, and color input/label. The current query enumerates whatever exists and asserts only a few IDs, so removing controls such as Undo, Redo, task-status-select, or importance-insert-select can pass. Check positive size and computed visibility for every expected control; bounding rectangles alone also allow visibility:hidden controls to pass.

Complete the required measurement evidence in the task reports: record header/save-row heights at 1025, 1280, 1536, 1601, and 1920px for RO and EN, describe wrapping, and record the requested screenshot inspection. The implementation report explicitly leaves these unmeasured, and successful geometry results are neither persisted nor reported by the suite. Run the completed suite in an authorized browser-capable environment and record the command/results; this review's browser launch was blocked and must not be counted as a layout test failure or pass.
